correctness.rationale: Verified independently: (1) Series formula W=1/f(-t/(1+t)) with Q=sum c_k(-t)^k(1+t)^{w-k} recomputed from clique vectors for all 995 rows — 0 mismatches. (2) Tree lemma Q=1-(n-2)t analytic; all eleven 7-trees have exactly Q=[1,-5,0], rate exactly 5, series 1,7,36,180,900,... confirmed. (3) Maximality: independent exact-Fraction Sturm recount gives 0 roots in (0,1/5] for all 971 non-trees; Q(1/5)>0 everywhere non-tree and Q(1/5)=0 nowhere, so radius of convergence >1/5 by Pringsheim (nonnegative coefficients) and every non-tree rate is <5; finite groups are exactly the 6 complete graphs (Q=1, rate None). (4) Enumeration: counts 1,2,6,21,112,853=995 match OEIS A001349; n<=6 canonical brute-force dedup confirms distinctness; n=7 within-invariant-bucket brute-force isomorphism check (861 pairs) finds 0 duplicates; 11 trees pairwise non-isomorphic; all graphs connected. (5) Cross-check: shipped verify.py re-ran clean (VERIFY_OK, BFS radius 5 all 995 via faithful integral Tits representation); runner-up Q=[1,-4,-4,0] root (sqrt2-1)/2 gives rate 2+2sqrt2~4.8284, gap 3-2sqrt2 verified. Minor presentation blemishes (verify.py docstring typo '2+sqrt2', float 4.9999... stored for exact-5 trees, omega notation clash) do not affect the exact Q-based proof.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp-based. Nearest priors: Okun-Scott (arXiv:1812.07755) proves general formula G=1/f_L(-t/(1+t)) reused by pipeline but enumerates no small-nerve table and no extremal; Terragni (arXiv:1312.3437) proves monotonicity and uniform lower bound tau~1.13 but tabulates no rates/extremals for n<=7 slice; Kolpakov-Talambutsa (arXiv:1809.09591) proves Perron-or-1 arithmetic type qualitatively with no finite census or maximal graph; Pilakkat-Rajendran 2026 multivariate extension gives general formula with only chordal examples, no exhaustive table. OEIS A001349 confirms scope counts only. Internal SCOPE044 covers opposite (minimal, golden-ratio) extremal on 4-6 vertices only; failed attempt SCOPE-FAIL-050 sought minimal growth in 7-9 window — different claim/scope. No prior found states or implies 'maximal rate over all 995 connected n<=7 RACGs is exactly 5 on exactly the eleven 7-trees' or tabulates the 995 exact denominators.

value.rationale: Headline judged separately from survey: rigorously established exact invariant (maximal spherical growth rate 5 with exact argmax set of eleven 7-vertex trees, each Q=1-5t, series (1+t)^2/(1-5t), certified gap 3-2sqrt2 to runner-up) of a natural object (all unlabelled connected graphs to 7 vertices / RACGs) motivated before computation by the recognized Coxeter-growth program (rationality/reciprocity, Terragni gaps, Perron rates, hyperbolicity benchmarks). Value not known or mechanically implied: maximality required Sturm certification over 971 polynomials, not just the elementary tree formula. A future growth-gap/hyperbolicity study could reasonably cite the exact rate, argmax, and denominator table as ground truth. Full 995-table plus certificate is a citable benchmark, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
